caption: The drawing depicts a pair of women’s shoes with a low heel and a pointed toe. Both shoes are illustrated in a combination of green, black, and pale beige colors. The shoe on the left is shown in side view, highlighting the light beige heel and the patterned upper part that consists of green and black overlapping shapes, resembling an abstract or reptile-skin motif. The shoe on the right is portrayed from an above angle, showing the interior which is a pale beige color and the same patterned exterior as the side view. Both shoes have a decorative element on the toe area, which appears as a gathered or ruffled ornament in a light beige shade. The background is plain and off-white, and the artist’s name, “LILLIAN CAUSEY,” is lightly written in small uppercase letters near the lower left corner of the image.
title: Woman's Slippers
